watchdog_ngos_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now
adversarial_framing_finding: In-window (2026-09-26) adversarial framing found: Iran's state broadcaster Press TV amplified a Yemeni claim casting Saudi Arabia as the aggressor striking civilian infrastructure. Qatar-linked Al Jazeera and Middle East Eye carried aggressor framing only out-of-window this cycle. Wire services (Reuters, AP) covering the same day framed Saudi Arabia as victim/interceptor. The Press TV item is carried as a Negative Articles item citing the framing outlet.
notes: Very thin, war-dominated cycle. Most reputational-edge coverage of the Saudi-Iran/Houthi war (e.g. Reuters exposure piece, WaPo nuclear-weapons story, AGBI deficit) fell just outside the 24h window and was correctly excluded, not padded. High-profile items that search summaries mislabelled as 2026 (Riyadh Comedy Festival backlash, EA/PIF buyout) were verified via WebFetch to be Sept-Oct 2025 and excluded. No NGO issued an in-window statement carried by a credible non-excluded outlet.
